slides.title: Where holiday deals go deepest
slides.sub: Ranked by Adobe's forecast peak online discount for 2026, off listed price.

slides.heading: #1 Electronics
body: Adobe expects electronics discounts to peak at 30% off listed price, about the same as last year (30.1%).
The deepest electronics deals are expected on Cyber Monday, Nov. 30.

slides.heading: #2 Toys
body: Toy discounts are expected to peak at 29%, up from 28% in 2025.
The best toy deals are expected on Black Friday, Nov. 27.

slides.heading: #3 A three-way tie
body: TVs, computers and apparel are all expected to peak at about 23% off.
TVs and apparel: best on Black Friday. Computers: best on Cyber Monday.

slides.heading: Forecast peak discount
slides.note: Off listed price, U.S. online sales, 2026 forecast

slides.takeaway: Make a list now. Buy on your category's best day, and stick to your budget.

posts.caption:
Black Friday is Nov. 27 and Cyber Monday is Nov. 30. Adobe's 2026 forecast says the deepest online discounts depend on what you're buying.

Electronics are expected to peak at 30% off listed price, with the best deals on Cyber Monday. Toys: 29%, best on Black Friday. TVs, computers and apparel: about 23%. In December, Adobe expects deals of only up to 10% to 15%.

These are forecasts, not promises. Make a list, set a budget and compare prices before you buy. Buy now, pay later is still borrowing, and Adobe expects $21.3 billion of it this season.

Data: Adobe Digital Insights 2026 holiday forecast (Sept. 28, 2026).
